script_text: Virgo, buckle up — Mercury retrograde in your 7th House of partnerships is about to flip your love life upside down this week. Early in the week, the Sun opposes Pluto, stirring deep power struggles in relationships — avoid confrontations Monday through Wednesday as old wounds surface. The turning point arrives Thursday when Mercury stations direct, finally clearing the fog and restoring honest communication with your partner or someone special. By the weekend, Venus forms a beautiful trine with Jupiter in your 10th House of career — expect a major money breakthrough or professional recognition, Virgo. Mars energizes your 6th House of health all week, reminding you to rest. Your best day is Thursday because Mercury breaks retrograde restoring truth and clarity. Your worst day is Monday because Sun opposite Pluto triggers intense emotional clashes with zero resolution. Take mercury's pause to revisit old plans rather than launch something new. Follow for daily cosmic updates.
